name: The Boost: cooperative and solo
body: Ability 1. Cooperative: the companion crouches at a `companion_stop` marked `boost` and a jump from her back launches higher than a normal jump. Solo: crates (plain blocks) at the same heights serve the same purpose. A 'streets' level teaches the solo crate first, then the cooperative form. Open for tuning: boost height relative to a normal jump (design says to resolve through a vertical slice).

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.
Built in PR #70: see docs/crimson-and-thorn-slice.md ('What slice 1 is, in the game') and the test engine/tests/host/the-streets-teach-the-boost.

acceptance_criteria: Boost height and trigger are tuned in PlayerTuning
The crate route and the companion route reach the same ledge
